senses.gloss: , m.(b. h.; sight, looks, appearance; color, shade.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 74b:15">Yoma 74ᵇ</cite> <he>מַרְאֵה עינים באשה</he> the pleasure of looking at one’s wife.

<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 1:2">Tosef. Neg. I, 2</cite> <he>מ׳ ראשון</he> the first inspection of a leprous affection (<cite ref="Leviticus 13:3">Lev. XIII, 3</cite>), <he>מ׳ שני</he> the second (ib. 5) &c. Ib. 4 <he>כל מ׳ לבן</he> all shades of white; <he>מ׳ סיבות</he> grey color. Ib. 5 <he>מ׳ גבוה</he> the appearance of an elevation; <he>כמ׳ צל בחמה</he> as the appearance of a shade thrown on a sunlit object; Sifra Thazr., <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:4">Neg., ch. I</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מַרְאוֹת</he> (with pronom. suffix) <he>מַרְאָיו</he>, <he>מַרְאֶיהָ</he> &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:1">Neg. I, 1</cite>. Sifra l. c., Par. 2, ch. II <he>במראיו</he> its retaining original color; <he>כהה ממראיו</he> fainter than its original color.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bekhorot 7:5">Bekh. VII, 5</cite>; v. <cite ref="H01820"><he>חָשׁוּךְ</he></cite>; a. fr.
